dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: A fully-equipped alchemy workshop? And arranged in a rather reasonable manner as well...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Even if an experiment goes, uh, explosively wrong in here, the specimens stored in the storage cabinets shouldn't be damaged...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Huh? Wh—When did you get here? I—I mean... I've been itching to conduct this experiment... I—Is it okay if I go ahead and do it?
